observations.observation: Replacement APK preserves local progress and resumes the fourth level; this restored entry does not replay the initial grass guide.
The real settings / Quit / confirmation route reaches the Level 4 failed dialog and the King sad animation.
Try Again creates a fresh attempt, restores the King idle animation after Sad, and presents the grass tutorial and 7x7 highlight. The guide is then dismissed through a normal OS tap.
A legal OS swap consumes one move, clears grass, cascades and refills before a cold restart of this package.

After Home / force-stop / cold launch, the HUD counters, 81 visible piece classes and grass mask are retained. The screenshot heuristic is corroborated by manual review; 3 of 81 center patches differ at the blue-piece hint animation, so rendered pixels are not identical.
A natural four-piece blue match creates a horizontal rocket that falls to (4,2).
Swapping that rocket upward triggers its row and removes grass with normal falling and refill.
Natural matches and cascades leave adjacent vertical and horizontal rockets at (6,2) and (6,1).
An ordinary swipe exchanges the adjacent rockets and triggers their cross combination.
A red 2x2 match naturally creates a propeller at (5,7).
Swapping the propeller downward clears its neighborhood and flies to a grass goal.
A second ordinary 2x2 match creates another propeller without arranging the board or editing local progress.
The second propeller removes an isolated grass cell. The idle hint highlights a valid final swap.
The 18th accepted swap removes the last grass. The goal check, King thumbs-up and animated victory logo are visible.
Without skip input, all 12 remaining moves convert to board powers. Their automatic activation and flying reward coins continue.
Conversion settles at 45 and the real Level 4 / Well Done / Continue result is visible.
Continue opens the fifth original shaped board, room background and normal King idle. A normal move hint is present; no new guide popup is observed.

limits: The production APK contains the committed King cached-move, Sad/retry, happy-flag and delayed coroutine fixes. Runtime state and native scheduler values are not instrumented on Android; exact scoped state/iterator comparisons and Unity probes remain in king_ui_lifecycle_evidence.json.

Eighteen real OS swaps complete a fresh fourth-level attempt. The visible captures and recordings are behavioral observations, not a frame-by-frame rendering, timing or audio comparison against the original app.

The cold restart retains the displayed counters, visible piece classes and grass mask. The classifier is only a screenshot heuristic, and 3 of 81 center patches differ because of hint animation; this is not byte-identical saved-model or rendered-pixel proof.
The screenshot classifier only assists the operator in choosing gestures. Special pieces are manually reviewed and overridden when needed. It is not shipped in the APK or used to change game state.
This round completes level 4 and enters level 5; it does not naturally complete all 100 levels or exercise Android bonus/Jester scenes.
The existing legacy bonus-80 required-shuffle test still fails on both baseline and fixed versions and is not claimed resolved by this APK check.
The original-app first-run terms/privacy confirmation remains untouched. Physical ARM64 touch and original-device image/audio/input parity remain unverified.
